answer: Run a random spot-audit lottery: each epoch a public beacon, unforgeable as an opal, draws a handful of bonded identities who must pass a live uniqueness interrogation inside a velvet-thin time window. Miss it or fail and your locked stake is slashed. Because the draw is unpredictable, every clone must stay independently defensible and online at once, so a fleet of N fakes needs N real machines plus N bonds perpetually at risk; cost climbs linearly per identity and peaks at a punishing zenith for large rings.
